mapper.select: SELECT rt.id as roomTypeId, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, COUNT(DISTINCT bo.id) as orderCount, SUM(bo.total_amount) as totalAmount FROM booking_order bo JOIN room_type rt ON bo.room_type_id = rt.id WHERE bo.status = 4 AND TRUNC(bo.check_in_date) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY rt.id, rt.type_name ORDER BY SUM(bo.total_amount) DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room WHERE room_type_id = #{roomTypeId}

SELECT NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN check_in_time IS NULL OR check_out_time IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ( LEAST(TRUNC(check_out_time), TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE})) - GREATEST(TRUNC(check_in_time), TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE})) ) + 1 END ), 0) as occupancyDays FROM check_in_record ci JOIN room r ON ci.room_id = r.id WHERE r.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND TRUNC(ci.check_in_time) <= TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND (ci.check_out_time IS NULL OR TRUNC(ci.check_out_time) >= TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}))

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date", SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 0 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as roomFee, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 1 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as depositFee, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 2 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as otherFee FROM income_record ir WHERE TRUNC(ir.payment_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TRUNC(ir.payment_time) ORDER BY TRUNC(ir.payment_time) ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') as "date", SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 0 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as roomFee, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 1 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as depositFee, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 2 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as otherFee FROM income_record ir WHERE TRUNC(ir.payment_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM'), TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM') ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') as "date", SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 0 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as roomFee, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 1 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as depositFee, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.type = 2 THEN ir.amount ELSE 0 END) as otherFee FROM income_record ir WHERE TRUNC(ir.payment_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY'), TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY') ORDER BY TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY') ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') as "date", SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 0 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as refundFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 1 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as purchaseFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 2 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as salaryFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 3 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as utilityFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 4 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as otherFee FROM expense_record er WHERE TRUNC(er.create_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM'), TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM') ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') as "date", SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 0 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as refundFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 1 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as purchaseFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 2 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as salaryFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 3 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as utilityFee, SUM(CASE WHEN er.type = 4 THEN er.amount ELSE 0 END) as otherFee FROM expense_record er WHERE TRUNC(er.create_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY'), TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY') ORDER BY TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY') ASC

WITH month_dates AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM'), level-1) as month_date, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM'), level-1), 'YYYY-MM') as "date" FROM dual CONNECT BY level <= MONTHS_BETWEEN( TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM'), TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'MM') ) + 1 ), income_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM') as month_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') as "date", SUM(ir.amount) as total_income FROM income_record ir WHERE TRUNC(ir.payment_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM'), TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'MM') ), expense_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM') as month_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') as "date", SUM(er.amount) as total_expense FROM expense_record er WHERE TRUNC(er.create_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM'), TRUNC(er.create_time, 'MM') ) SELECT md."date", NVL(i.total_income, 0) as income, NVL(e.total_expense, 0) as expense FROM month_dates md LEFT JOIN income_data i ON md."date" = i."date" LEFT JOIN expense_data e ON md."date" = e."date" ORDER BY md.month_date ASC

WITH year_dates AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'YYYY'), (level-1)*12) as year_date, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}, 'YYYY'), (level-1)*12), 'YYYY') as "date" FROM dual CONNECT BY level <= ( EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) ) + 1 ), income_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY') as year_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') as "date", SUM(ir.amount) as total_income FROM income_record ir WHERE TRUNC(ir.payment_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY'), TRUNC(ir.payment_time, 'YYYY') ), expense_data AS ( SELECT TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY') as year_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY') as "date", SUM(er.amount) as total_expense FROM expense_record er WHERE TRUNC(er.create_time) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) AND TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY'), 'YYYY'), TRUNC(er.create_time, 'YYYY') ) SELECT yd."date", NVL(i.total_income, 0) as income, NVL(e.total_expense, 0) as expense FROM year_dates yd LEFT JOIN income_data i ON yd."date" = i."date" LEFT JOIN expense_data e ON yd."date" = e."date" ORDER BY yd.year_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room WHERE status != 0

WITH day_dates AS ( SELECT TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) + (level-1) as full_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE}) + (level-1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "date" FROM dual CONNECT BY level <= (TRUNC(#{endDate, jdbcType=DATE}) - TRUNC(#{startDate, jdbcType=DATE})) + 1 ) SELECT dd."date", NVL(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT room_id) FROM check_in_record WHERE TRUNC(check_in_time) <= dd.full_date AND (check_out_time IS NULL OR TRUNC(check_out_time) > dd.full_date) ), 0) as occupiedRooms FROM day_dates dd ORDER BY dd.full_date ASC
